title: Stop ends a loop of three identical no-edit refusals
body:
Astra audit B7 (verified): repeated identical Stop refusals are classified only after the session process ends (evals/replay/session-result.ts:114,225); src/hook/stop.ts has no loop counter, so a session that cannot satisfy Stop burns budget until its timeout.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, test/hook/stop-loop-limit.test.ts
Outcome: after three identical no-edit refusals in one session, Stop allows the stop and records a stop-loop verdict; the test exits 0.
Proof: node --test test/hook/stop-loop-limit.test.ts passes.
